items.note: S1.1.1.1.1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the three-stage exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoration of scratch wires, matching Lemma lem:scalar-motifs; it omits the forward-invocation content y_S<-y_S+x_S, the neighbor rule, h=100 and the triple indexing, and gives no derivation (single infer step).

S1.1.1.1.2 gives per-vertex invertible frames, the commutation of a common frame with pointwise gates, and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, as in lines 804-826; it is an infer step, not a derivation.

The sub-steps correctly give the triple inner products, terminal labels and the signed sum Wm-2N, the lemma (only center 3->4 edges decrease, by h; L=Ich; sum Wm-2N+2L) and the ratios 100/539, 101/539. But the essential stage-transition labels, gate-label table eq:motif-labels and residual table that prove the lemma are not reconstructed (S1.1.1.1.3.3 just restates it), and the orthonormal-basis part over F_2 is omitted.

The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m and s_b<W_b m are stated, and S1.1.1.1.8 gives the shear H<-H+D on every row. Missing: the projection assignment P_U and -P_{U_a}, the rank formula s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b and why rank equals dimension change.

S1.1.2.1 correctly states one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual basis vector, total s_c<W_c m and C^{tensor m} on every role. It does not define the phase frames C_U and omits the formula s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c. The diagonal source and sink corrections appear only in S1.1.2.3.4.
The plan states s_b<W_b m, s_c<W_c m, L/N<1/2, s/W<m^tau and tau=1-2^{-50}. It omits the deficits eta_b, eta_c and the check (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20) that turns them into tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.

Only alluded to: 'linear-cost updates' (S1.1.1.1.9), the 'O(V) controlled cyclic shift' (S1.1.2.5.3) and relies-on links to stream-ops and controlled-shifts. Neither lemma's content (digit moves, split/merge, cyclic row split, controlled shift with b^{O(1)} offset) is stated.
Both lemmas are stated exactly (A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones; the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V)). They are infer steps without the elimination proof or the three-update interchange trick.

The plan follows the proof of prop:power-interchange: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on each edge via matrix shears, shear on every row, interchange by D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and the fixed-tape DFS schedule at O(V) per node.

The route is lemma chunk-swap's: top rho=O(log) digits form a row field R>=W^k padded below 2V, the base-m decomposition of the remaining width gives sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and binary ranges are padded to [q^e]. The fixed tau=1-2^{-50} matches line 1621.

Conjugation by P_M (eq:phase-edge-coordinate), the inverse child via (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, basis changes as row additions, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D are all present, in the paper's order.

The plan has the eight packed cyclic shifts (parity flip, w restored), the bad set of fraction <=80(f-1)2^{-K}, repair by extracting and stably radix-sorting by destination rank, rotations via chunk interchange plus controlled shift, and the cost terms, all matching the paper.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), and the base-m sum to O(d^{lambda'}) all follow the paper.

S1.1.2 has the layer as H_0^{tensor D} on one selected bit per chunk in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with one truncation error <sqrt2 2^{-p}. Its children reproduce the C-reduction, recursion, guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with eps C_1<1, and the absolute-row-sum argument.

F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I, DIF with bit-reversed storage B_tF_t^-/F_t^+B_t^{-1}, grouping into H then J_E, the layout L (prefix moves, at most Dq-1 K-chunk exchanges), the per-round layer cost, the truncation commuting with J_E, error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, and cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]) all match.

S1.2 states evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the established multiplier, centered extraction, negacyclic wrap and output Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp)), as in lem:signed-ring-product. It is an infer step with no derivation.

The plan gives two forwards kept in LB order, signed-packed pointwise products, the opposite transform and exact scale by M, the normalization F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) with F^+F^-=I/M, permutation commuting with pointwise products, the error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the cost, as in the proof.

The plan has the one-dimensional identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with the permutations retained, the N=CTD invertibility, A=S', B_0=D'J'C, errors <p^2 and costs, then tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2, linewise application with error dp^2, and axis exposure O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)). This follows lines 3576-3897.

The source-permutation cancellation (RF_s^+)[(RF_su).(RF_sv)]=(u*v)/S^2 is stated exactly in S3.7.1. The chirp identity in S3.5.1.3 gives neither the chirp a_j nor the 1/T normalization, and calls the first factor 'a chirp phase' where the paper uses the conjugate chirp on both sides. No derivation is given.

The size parameters, alpha, gamma, the prime intervals with gcd=1, T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta>p and no wraparound are stated correctly. Missing: the fixed rational exponents (lambda, c, lambda', eps, delta), eta=1/(4d) and the Rosser-Schoenfeld prime count.

S3.4 gives Phi: x->prod x_i^{mu_i} as an isomorphism preserving cyclic convolution, implemented by triangular controlled shifts at cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)). mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i and the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i}a_jP_j are not given.

S3.5.1.1 gives the twist x_d->zeta y as an isomorphism with the wrap check, and S3.5.1.2 gives M_C=(f*g)/T by twist, synthetic convolution and untwist with truncated phase products, matching the paper. The twist error constants are left to S3.7.2.

The source transform (A, chirp transform, B_0, scale 2^gamma; exact counterpart RF_s; opposite by conjugation) and the six-step algorithm (digits, Phi, two source transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries) follow the paper. The input scale 2^{-b-2} is only implied by 'scaled radix digits'.
The error chain 5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2), 28 2^gamma T^2L, the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding to c_j<2^{3b} and carry propagation all match lines 4546-4806.

The cost table normalized by Tp, the seven margins with min=2^{-181}=2kappa, o(V) setup and exceptional-stream sorting, the absorption of log powers by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff all follow the paper.

No step says why the bound refutes an eventual n lg n lower bound (liminf argument). S0 only states the time bound, and its relies-on link to 'nlogn-conjecture' names the conjecture, not this negation argument.

errors.says: the total dimension L lost on decreasing edges stays below N/2 'for the N data banks'
errors.paper: There are two data banks X_a,Y_a indexed by a in T^3; N=v^3 is the number of indices a (the dimension sum of the X_a source labels), not a number of banks.

errors.says: a DFT with frequency permutation Q equals premultiplication by a chirp phase, a cyclic convolution with the chirp, and postmultiplication by the conjugate chirp
errors.paper: QF_t u = a-bar . (a*(a-bar . u))/T: both endpoint multiplications use the conjugate chirp a-bar, and the convolution is normalized by 1/T.

errors.says: applying the f-fold child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots
errors.paper: There are only m slots. Each edge applies one child per residual basis vector on slots 1..rho_edge, and the s_c calls are the total over all edges of the network.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: two fast procedures (chunk interchange via the bit network, simultaneous layer via the complex network), synthetic transforms and convolution, Gaussian resampling with retained permutations, the chirp and CRT reductions, exact recovery and the cost table. It is thinnest at the source of the saving. The label construction is asserted rather than derived (no gate-label or residual tables), the rational interface omits the projection matrices and the rank-equals-dimension-change argument, and the certification of tau=1-2^{-50} from eta and log m is missing.

steps.note: The bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch wires and the gate types are stated. h=100, the triple indexing of the data pairs, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are absent (m appears only as 'the m-dimensional space'), so the defining quantities are missing.
The step gives a frame per source, gate and sink, a common frame commuting with pointwise gates, and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, so only endpoint frames matter.

The plan has nondegenerate subspace labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m from triple indicators, neighboring lines orthogonal, comparable labels on every edge, and only central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h. The gate-label table itself is not given.

The plan never says that P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, nor that the N source edges are rank-one exceptions. It only alludes to 'the extra N source ranks of the rational interface' and a 'total edge rank'.
The signed sum Wm-2N, L=Ich and the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L are explicit. The rank sum s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b is only conveyed in words, through the extra N source ranks.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are below 1/2, leaving a strict saving after the extra N source ranks, so s_b<W_b m.
The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m is stated, and S1.1.1.1.8 derives the shear H<-H+D on every row, including scratch rows. The projection matrices are not named.
The steps give A=E_1 Pi E_2, a rank-a shear costing exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the motivation that an edge of rank a costs a smaller interchanges, with ranks summing below Wm.

Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau and F_k=O(e^tau) are present, with tau=1-2^{-50} stated in S1.1.1. The certification of tau (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20) is missing, so this verdict is generous on the exponent half.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs most of the chain behind the saving: frames, labels with only central 3->4 losses, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity and shear, edge ranks as recursive calls, and the recurrence to O(e^tau). The fixed network's parameters (h=100, triples, N, m) are missing, as is the rank-equals-dimension-change argument with its N rank-one source exceptions. The numerical certification of tau=1-2^{-50} is also absent.
